Bundled browser libraries for the discussion Markdown view:

- Marked 18.0.14, from npm package marked@18.0.14, MIT license in LICENSE.marked.
  Upstream: https://github.com/markedjs/marked
- DOMPurify 3.4.16, from npm package dompurify@3.4.16, Apache-2.0 option
  of its dual license in LICENSE.dompurify.
  Upstream: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify

These are unmodified upstream distribution files. Wanglai's homegrown renderer
was reviewed but not copied because it lacks complete CommonMark/GFM behavior.
Chatbox's GPL-3.0 React model-selector code was reviewed for interaction only;
none of its code is included here.
